svg.title: The slow control: persistence p99 under its 23 ms max, d over its 0.35 ms tolerance
svg.desc: Two panels over the same gates, A/A first, in their sets' order, then the slow control's. Top: the release cell's persistence p99, ms, against the stored max, 23 ms. Bottom: d, the release's reading less the incumbent's in the same gate, ms, against R7's tolerance, 0.35 ms. A circle an A/A gate, both arms server 1.31.0: d -0.181 to 0.163. A triangle a gate of the control, which delays every packet into the release cell's Postgres: R7 read it WORSE in each. The 1 ms toxic's four gates of that control ran in recording mode and are left out. Sources: docs/tables/compare.jsonl, docs/tables/gates.jsonl, gate/sets/calibration-arm-3item-m8i.8xlarge.txt, gate/sets/control-arm-known-slow.txt, gate/sets/validation-arm-3item-m8i.8xlarge.txt, load/steady-state.yaml.
svg.text: The slow control: persistence p99 under its 23 ms max, d over its 0.35 ms tolerance
Its 6 judged gates read 9.6 to 9.7 ms, d 1.36 to 1.87 ms; 50 A/A gates beside; the lab host, an m8i.8xlarge
